highlights.title: Share to Mewla from any app
highlights.line: A picture, file or link from another app lands in Brain's composer, ready to send.

highlights.title: Git turns amber with changes
highlights.line: A Session's Git button turns amber when its folder has changes. Tap it to review.

highlights.title: Finished Work closes itself
highlights.line: Once Brain has the result, done Work leaves your list. Brain reopens it if needed.

try.target: What Work did you close today?
